    Lemma 2.9 with the standard homological notions #

    The hypotheses of projectiveEvaluationCriterion are stated through what the proof uses: Ext¹-vanishing in Yoneda form (ExtVan) and gl.dim ≤ 2 as "kernels of maps between projectives are projective" (GlDimLeTwo). Here they are derived from Mathlib's notions:

    • gl.dim R ≤ 2: every R-module has projective dimension at most two (GlobalDimLE2, Mathlib's HasProjectiveDimensionLE), gives GlDimLeTwo (glDimLeTwo_of_globalDim, from the two short exact sequences of a map between projectives);
    • Ext¹_R(T, Q) = 0 for Mathlib's Ext (ExtOneVan) gives ExtVan (extVan_of_extOneVan, from the contravariant long exact sequence of Ext). So Lemma 2.9 holds with the hypotheses as stated (projectiveEvaluationCriterion_std), and the check on simples is van_of_simple_std.

        Lemma 2.9 (lem:projective-evaluation-criterion) with the standard notions: assume Hom_R(T, R) = 0 and Ext¹_R(T, R) = 0 (Mathlib's Ext) for all finite-dimensional T with εT = 0. Then (1) P ↦ εP is fully faithful on finite-dimensional projectives; (2) if moreover gl.dim R ≤ 2 (every module has projective dimension ≤ 2) and every finite-dimensional injective Λ_e-module is εQ for a finite-dimensional projective Q, it is essentially surjective onto finite-dimensional Λ_e-modules and Λ_e is representation-finite.
